name: PhysioNet Challenge 2012: ICU Mortality Prediction
description: The PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2012 dataset consists of multi-parameter clinical time series from 12,000 Intensive Care Unit (ICU) admissions at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center. Collected during the first 48 hours following ICU admission, each record includes static demographic descriptors alongside repeated physiological measurements (e.g. heart rate, blood pressure, Glasgow Coma Scale, serum glucose, lactate). It is a classic benchmark for irregularly sampled clinical time series modeling.
